title: Pay a Real Price
era: Late Eastern Han · about 1,800 years ago

source.quote: No one harms himself; a hurt must be real to be believed. Make the false true and the true false, and the wedge will work. The simple youth is fortunate: he follows and yields.

moral: Meaning it is not enough: put out something others can see, and then they believe you.
transfer: Show you mean it with one real act of help.
